title: Production Deployment of Microservices on GCP Cloud Run
description: A hands-on DevOps course covering serverless container deployment on Google Cloud Run, Direct VPC egress, Cloud SQL integration, and Secret Manager.
body: Deploy production containerized workloads on Google Cloud Run. Master multi-stage Docker builds, gcloud deployment CLI commands, Direct VPC egress networking for internal database communication, and Secret Manager bindings.

lessons.title: Lesson 1.1: Building Minimal Multi-Stage Docker Images
lessons.body:
### Multi-Stage Dockerfile for Go Microservices
Keep container images under 30MB to reduce security vulnerabilities and eliminate container deployment cold starts.

sections.title: Section 2: Production Deployment & Direct VPC Egress

lessons.title: Lesson 2.1: Production `gcloud run deploy` Specification
lessons.body:
```bash
gcloud run deploy gg-cms-backend \
  --image gcr.io/ggcms/backend:latest \
  --region us-central1 \
  --min-instances 1 \
  --max-instances 10 \
  --network default \
  --subnet default \
  --vpc-egress private-ranges-only \
  --set-secrets "DB_WRITE_URL=gg-cms-db-write-url:latest"
```

lessons.title: Lesson 2.2: Connecting Cloud Run to Private Cloud SQL / Compute Engine VMs
lessons.body: Route database traffic securely through internal VPC RFC 1918 IPs using `--vpc-egress private-ranges-only`.
